A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RAUQ research and contain complete, corresponding main text and Appendices A–H. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of all equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations across four LLMs and 12 datasets, attention-pattern analyses, ablations, runtime measurements and supervised-method comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main evaluations and the ablations, additional comparisons and detailed results in the appendices.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same attention-head selection, recurrent confidence computation, logarithmic token aggregation and maximum aggregation across layers.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same seven QA datasets, three summarization datasets and two translation datasets. The in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios in Appendix D.2 are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The main comparisons retain the same 15 baselines, including Focus, Simple Focus and Semantic Entropy. Tables 9–10 retain the same seven supervised comparators, and Table 2 retains the same Attention Score variants.

E3.justification: The model configurations, hyperparameters, sample counts, few-shot settings and generation parameters match. The first-50% PRR evaluation, ROC-AUC thresholds in Appendix D.1 and supervised evaluation designs in Appendix D.2 are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the attention-pattern analyses, Figure 5 hyperparameter sensitivity study, Table 2 component comparisons, Tables 5–7 aggregation and recurrence ablations, and Appendix F qualitative examples. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the runtime values with ± quantities in Table 4. Neither version adds seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedures relative to the other.

E6.justification: All corresponding numerical results and plotted findings match, including appendix results. For example, RAUQ's overall mean PRR remains 0.414 in Table 1 and its mean ROC-AUC remains 0.692 in Table 8.

T1.justification: The attention definitions in Section 3 and Equations (1)–(4) in Section 4 are unchanged. No formal assumption, mathematical derivation, theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about uncertainty-aware heads, unsupervised single-pass RAUQ, performance across four LLMs and 12 datasets, and less than 1% latency overhead.

C2.justification: The explanations of attention-head selection, recurrence and generalization remain unchanged. Appendix G retains the same limitations concerning white-box access and the validation data needed for dataset-specific hyperparameter tuning.

D1.justification: The generation details in Appendix A and the single-batch, 80GB NVIDIA H100 runtime setup in Section 5.4 are retained. No implementation, reproducibility or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same discussion and positioning against prior attention-based uncertainty methods. The same 54 references appear in both versions.

P1.justification: v2 updates author affiliations and a contact email, including Independent Researcher and RUDN University entries, and updates the version/date stamp. Three references to appendices become references to sections; the remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: There are limited typesetting changes around the updated affiliation block and small text-spacing differences. Figures 1–9 and Tables 1–14 retain their designs, caption wording and placements; no scientific display is added, removed or reorganized.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the method, empirical evidence, technical disclosures and limitations throughout the main text and appendices. The affiliation/contact updates and limited presentation edits do not materially improve or impair the paper's overall quality.
